stem: A mass is hung freely from the end of a spring. A boy then slowly pushes the mass upwards until the spring just becomes slack. The gain in gravitational potential energy of the mass during this process is:

options.A: Equal to the work done by the boy on the mass.
options.B: Greater than the work done by the boy on the mass.
options.C: Less than the work done by the boy on the mass.
options.D: Can be greater or less than the work done by the boy depending on the stiffness of spring
